item.title: Houston residents turning to costly payday loans at alarming rates for food and rent, survey finds
item.description: A new survey shows Houston residents are using payday loans at nearly 11 times the national rate, often to cover food and housing costs.

item.title: Fort Bend ISD survey fuels heated debate as parents push back on proposed school closures
item.description: Fort Bend ISD parents have expressed strong opposition to proposed school closures and rezoning, citing concerns over the impact on students and neighborhoods, as well as the psychological impact on children.

item.title: Construction accident cuts power in Webster, CenterPoint Energy says
item.description: A construction vehicle knocked over a power line in Webster that led to a power outage in the area on Tuesday morning, according to CenterPoint Energy officials.

item.title: Feds, Texas reach $68 million settlement with Colony Ridge developers
item.description: The developers will pay $68 million in penalties and in exchange will not face any charges and will deny any wrongdoing.

item.title: 18-wheeler crash on I-45 North Freeway at West Road, all southbound lanes reopened
item.description: An 18-wheeler crashed on the I-45 North Freeway that has forced closure of the southbound lanes at West Road on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: A Houston teen was nominated for a NAACP Image Award. How you can vote for his win
item.description: Jeremiah J. Felder, a 13-year-old actor from Houston, has been nominated for an NAACP Image Award for his role in the Netflix series "The Residence."

item.title: Surveillance photos of 'armed individual' at Nancy Guthrie's house released
item.description: The photos were "previously inaccessible," FBI Director Kash Patel said Tuesday.

item.title: Is Houston done with freezes and frosts?
item.description: With the Lunar New Year approaching and Houston's weather finally warming up, now is a great time to start planting seeds and prepping beds for the season.

item.title: Montrose street closed due to water main break, HPD says
item.description: A water main break has forced a busy street in the Montrose area of Houston to close on Tuesday, police said.

item.title: Person detained for questioning in Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Sources tell NewsNation the person was detained south of Tucson.
